how to generate radiology bill invoice

To generate a radiology bill invoice, follow these steps: 
1. When the patient is ready to make the payment, click on the ‘Estimate’ button to view estimated bills. 
2. Double-click on the estimated bill to proceed with the payment. 
3. Click on the 'Print Bill' checkbox to generate a printout of the service bill. 
4. If needed, click on the 'Print Deduct Bill' checkbox for the deduct bill. 
5. Finally, click the ‘Save’ button to generate the service bill. 

For more details, refer to the image below:
![Related Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_113427.png)

The CScan form is used to scan the cards submitted by the patients (e.g., Insurance Card). This screen can be accessed by clicking the ‘CScan’ button from the OP service billing screen. To use the CScan functionality, follow these steps: 
1. Enter the file number in the designated field. You can either enter it manually or select it using the nearby button. For manual entry, just enter digits (except zero) and press the enter key; the remaining characters will be filled automatically (e.g., type 223823 and press enter, it will change to 000223823L).
2. Click on the ‘Scan’ button to add documents submitted by the patient.
3. Click on the ‘CScan’ button to add cards submitted by the patient.
4. All attached documents can be viewed by clicking the ‘VScan’ button, where they can also be printed, downloaded, or converted to PDF format.
5. To allocate cash and credit schemes to patients, click the ‘Credit’ and ‘Cash’ buttons.
6. Click the ‘History’ button to view the patient’s visit history.
7. Assign either premium or normal priority to the patient as needed.
8. To make a payment, click the ‘Save’ button, which will show the payable amount details. Payments can be made using cash or card, with options for credit or debit cards available.

For more details, refer to the image below:
![Related Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114308.png)

Various discounts can be applied for the patients, such as user-wise limit discount and date-wise discount. If any billing user has the privilege to give a discount, it can be applied on the billing screen up to the limits specified for that particular user. To associate any discount profile with a patient's bill, select the details from the ‘Reference’ field and then click on the ‘Apply’ button. A discount will be automatically applied on the bill. 

For more details, refer to the image below:
![Related Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114457.png)
